title: Core Deployment Data Schema with 30-Day Completeness Validation
description: Extended JSON schema for deployment data validation with strict 30-day completeness requirements. Validates structure and enforces completeness constraints for deployment data covering a continuous 30-day period.

metadata.description: Metadata about the deployment data generation and coverage period

generated_at.description: Timestamp when deployment data was generated (ISO 8601 format)

data_period_start.description: Start of the 30-day analysis period (ISO 8601 format). For completeness validation, the period from data_period_start to data_period_end must be at least 30 days.

data_period_end.description: End of the 30-day analysis period (ISO 8601 format). Must be at least 30 days after data_period_start for completeness validation.

data_sources.description: Data sources used to compile deployment information

current_image.description: Current container image in use (format: registry/image:tag)

last_updated.description: Most recent deployment update timestamp (ISO 8601 format)

metrics.description: Deployment metrics for the 30-day analysis period

total_deployments.description: Total number of deployments in the 30-day analysis period

successful_deployments.description: Number of successful deployments in the 30-day period

failed_deployments.description: Number of failed or scaled-down deployments in the 30-day period

deployment_success_rate.description: Deployment success rate as decimal (0.0 to 1.0) for the 30-day period

last_deployment_timestamp.description: Last deployment timestamp within the 30-day period (ISO 8601 format)

days_since_last_deployment.description: Days since the last deployment (capped at 30+ for periods beyond 30 days)

rollbacks.description: Number of rollback operations in the 30-day period

deployment_frequency_days.description: Average days between deployments calculated over the 30-day period

analysis_period_days.description: Length of the analysis period in days. Must be at least 30 for completeness validation.

replica_history.description: Historical ReplicaSet data covering the 30-day analysis period. For completeness validation, this array should include all deployments within the period with no significant gaps (>7 days).

image.description: Container image used in this ReplicaSet

replicas.description: Number of replicas in this ReplicaSet

days_ago.description: Days since this ReplicaSet was created (0-30 days)

completeness.description: 30-day completeness validation metrics. This section is required for 30-day completeness validation and must pass all checks for the data to be considered complete.

errorMessage.type: Completeness validation section is required but missing. Add a 'completeness' object with period_coverage_days, data_coverage_percent, gaps_detected, and meets_completeness_threshold fields.

period_coverage_days.description: Number of days covered by the deployment data. Must be at least 30 for completeness validation.

errorMessage.minimum: Period coverage is only {actual} days. Required minimum: 30 days for completeness validation. SHORTFALL: {30 - actual} days. ACTION: Extend the data collection period from '{data_period_start}' to '{data_period_end}' by at least {30 - actual} more days, or expand the analysis period to cover a full 30-day window.
errorMessage.type: Period coverage days must be an integer value representing the total days covered by deployment data. Current value: '{actual}' is invalid type.

data_coverage_percent.description: Percentage of the 30-day period with deployment data coverage. For completeness validation, this should be 100% or meet the minimum threshold (default 95%).

errorMessage.pattern: Invalid data coverage percentage format: '{actual}'. REQUIRED FORMAT: 'XX%' with % symbol (e.g., '95%', '100%', '87%'). CURRENT VALUE: '{actual}' does not match pattern. ACTION: Provide coverage as a percentage string from '0%' to '100%' ending with % symbol.
errorMessage.type: Data coverage percent must be a string value like '95%' or '100%'. Current type: {actual}.

gaps_detected.description: Whether data gaps were detected in the 30-day period. For completeness validation, this should be false.

errorMessage.type: Gaps detected must be a boolean value (true/false). Current value: '{actual}' is invalid type. ACTION: Provide a boolean value: 'true' if gaps exist, 'false' if coverage is complete.
errorMessage.custom: GAPS DETECTED: Data gaps found in deployment coverage. SEVERITY: See gap_details array. CRITICAL GAPS: >7 days prevent completeness validation. WARNING GAPS: 3-7 days indicate partial coverage. ACTION: Review gap_details array for specific missing periods (gap_start_days_ago, gap_end_days_ago, gap_duration_days). Fill missing deployment data or extend data collection period.

gap_details.description: List of gaps detected in the deployment data. For completeness validation, this array should be empty or only contain gaps <3 days. Each gap includes start, end, duration, severity, and affected data types.

errorMessage.type: Gap details must be an array of gap objects, even if empty. Current type: '{actual}'. ACTION: Provide an array (e.g., []) of gap objects with structure: {gap_start_days_ago, gap_end_days_ago, gap_duration_days, severity, missing_data_types}.
errorMessage.custom: DATA GAPS FOUND: {length} gap(s) detected in coverage period. REVIEW REQUIRED: Each gap entry specifies duration (gap_duration_days), severity (critical: >7 days, warning: 3-7 days, info: <3 days), and missing data types. CRITICAL GAPS: Gaps >7 days prevent completeness validation. ACTION: 1) Identify missing periods from gap_details, 2) Collect missing deployment data for those periods, 3) Re-run completeness validation, or 4) Document why gaps are acceptable (e.g., service decommissioned).

gap_start_days_ago.description: Days ago when the gap started (relative to data_period_end)

errorMessage.minimum: INVALID GAP TIMING: gap_start_days_ago cannot be negative. CURRENT VALUE: '{actual}' days ago. REQUIRED: 0 or more days ago (relative to data_period_end). INTERPRETATION: Negative values indicate gap starts in the future, which is impossible. ACTION: Check gap calculation logic - ensure gap_start_days_ago = (data_period_end - gap_start_date).days is always non-negative.
errorMessage.type: Gap start days ago must be an integer relative to the analysis period end. Current value: '{actual}' has invalid type. ACTION: Provide integer representing days ago when gap started (e.g., 25 means gap started 25 days before period end).

gap_end_days_ago.description: Days ago when the gap ended (relative to data_period_end)

errorMessage.minimum: INVALID GAP TIMING: gap_end_days_ago cannot be negative. CURRENT VALUE: '{actual}' days ago. REQUIRED: 0 or more days ago (relative to data_period_end). INTERPRETATION: Negative values indicate gap ends in the future, which is impossible. ACTION: Verify gap_end_days_ago = (data_period_end - gap_end_date).days calculation produces non-negative result.
errorMessage.type: Gap end days ago must be an integer relative to the analysis period end. Current value: '{actual}' has invalid type. ACTION: Provide integer representing days ago when gap ended (e.g., 20 means gap ended 20 days before period end).

gap_duration_days.description: Duration of the gap in days

errorMessage.minimum: INVALID GAP DURATION: gap_duration_days must be at least 1 day. CURRENT VALUE: '{actual}' days. REQUIRED: Minimum 1 day (gaps of 0 days should not be recorded as gaps). INTERPRETATION: 0-day gaps indicate no actual missing data. ACTION: Either remove this gap entry from gap_details (if no actual gap exists) or verify gap calculation: gap_duration_days = (gap_end_date - gap_start_date).days must be >= 1.
errorMessage.type: Gap duration must be an integer representing days in the gap. Current value: '{actual}' has invalid type. ACTION: Provide integer >= 1 representing the number of days in this gap.

severity.description: Gap severity level based on duration. Critical: >7 days, Warning: 3-7 days, Info: <3 days

errorMessage.enum: INVALID SEVERITY LEVEL: Severity must be one of: 'critical', 'warning', or 'info'. CURRENT VALUE: '{actual}'. SEVERITY CLASSIFICATION: 'critical' = gap >7 days (prevents completeness validation), 'warning' = gap 3-7 days (partial coverage concern), 'info' = gap <3 days (minor gap, often acceptable). ACTION: Map gap_duration_days to correct severity: if gap_duration_days > 7 → 'critical', if 3 <= gap_duration_days <= 7 → 'warning', if gap_duration_days < 3 → 'info'.
errorMessage.type: Severity must be a string value. Current value: '{actual}' has invalid type. ACTION: Provide string value: 'critical', 'warning', or 'info' based on gap duration.

missing_data_types.description: Types of data missing during this gap

meets_completeness_threshold.description: Whether the deployment data meets the minimum completeness threshold (default: 95% coverage for 30-day period). For completeness validation, this should be true.

errorMessage.type: Completeness threshold must be a boolean value (true/false). Current value: '{actual}' is invalid type. ACTION: Provide boolean: 'true' if coverage meets threshold, 'false' if below threshold.
errorMessage.custom: COMPLETENESS THRESHOLD NOT MET: Deployment data fails minimum coverage requirements. COVERAGE: {data_coverage_percent} actual vs {completeness_threshold_percent} required. SHORTFALL: Calculate missing percentage gap. ROOT CAUSES: 1) Data gaps in replica_history (see gap_details), 2) Insufficient period length (<30 days), 3) Missing deployment events. ACTIONS: 1) Extend data collection period to cover full 30-day window, 2) Fill missing deployment data from gap_details periods, 3) Verify replica_history has no gaps >7 days, 4) Consider adjusting completeness_threshold_percent if current threshold is too strict for this use case.

completeness_threshold_percent.description: Minimum completeness threshold required for 30-day validation. Default is 95%, but can be set to 100% for strict validation.

errorMessage.pattern: INVALID THRESHOLD FORMAT: Completeness threshold must be in format 'XX%' with % symbol. CURRENT VALUE: '{actual}'. REQUIRED FORMAT: Percentage string from '0%' to '100%' ending with % (e.g., '95%', '100%', '80%'). COMMON THRESHOLDS: '95%' (default, allows 5% gaps), '100%' (strict, requires zero gaps), '90%' (lenient). ACTION: Update completeness_threshold_percent to match pattern '^(100|[1-9]?[0-9])%$'.
errorMessage.type: Completeness threshold must be a string percentage value. Current value: '{actual}' has invalid type. ACTION: Provide string like '95%' or '100%' with % symbol.

minimum_deployment_days.description: Minimum number of deployment days required in the 30-day period. Default is 1, but can be increased for stricter validation.

errorMessage.minimum: Minimum deployment days cannot be negative. Current: '{actual}'. Expected: 0 or more days.
errorMessage.type: Minimum deployment days must be an integer value.

actual_deployment_days.description: Actual number of distinct days with deployments in the 30-day period

errorMessage.minimum: Actual deployment days cannot be negative. Current: '{actual}'. Expected: 0 or more days with deployment activity.
errorMessage.type: Actual deployment days must be an integer count of days with deployments.

deployment_days_threshold_met.description: Whether the minimum deployment days threshold is met. For completeness validation, this should be true.

errorMessage.type: Deployment days threshold must be a boolean value (true/false). Current value: '{actual}' is invalid type. ACTION: Provide boolean: 'true' if deployment days meet minimum, 'false' if below minimum.
errorMessage.custom: DEPLOYMENT DAYS THRESHOLD NOT MET: Insufficient deployment activity in analysis period. ACTUAL DEPLOYMENT DAYS: {actual_deployment_days} distinct days with deployments vs REQUIRED MINIMUM: {minimum_deployment_days} days. SHORTFALL: {minimum_deployment_days - actual_deployment_days} deployment days missing. ROOT CAUSES: 1) New deployment with limited history, 2) Deployment paused during analysis period, 3) Insufficient replica_history coverage. ACTIONS: 1) Verify replica_history captures all deployment events, 2) Check deployment occurred on distinct days (not same day multiple times), 3) Extend analysis period to capture more deployment activity, 4) Adjust minimum_deployment_days if deployment frequency is lower than expected for this service.

pod_health.description: Current pod health and runtime statistics

total_restarts.description: Total container restarts across all pods

storage.description: Storage information for PVCs and volumes

summary.description: Summary statistics for the 30-day analysis period

overall_health_status.description: Overall service health status based on 30-day deployment data

data_coverage.description: Percentage of data coverage over the 30-day period (e.g., '100%')

gaps_detected.description: Whether data gaps were detected in the 30-day period

largest_gap_days.description: Size of the largest gap in days within the 30-day period

recommendation.description: Operational recommendation based on 30-day deployment data analysis

minimum_period_days.description: Minimum required analysis period in days for completeness validation

strict_coverage_threshold.description: Strict coverage percentage threshold (no gaps allowed)

critical_gap_days.description: Gap duration in days that triggers critical severity

warning_gap_days.description: Gap duration in days that triggers warning severity

minimum_deployment_events.description: Minimum number of deployment events required

minimum_deployment_days.description: Minimum number of distinct days with deployments

gap_details.description: When completeness threshold is not met, gap_details must contain at least one entry explaining the failure
